question: Which of the following phenomena illustrates that “a moving surface generates a solid”?
solution: A right triangle is a surface, and rotating it produces a cone, a solid figure, illustrating that a moving surface generates a solid. A windshield wiper illustrates that a moving line generates a surface; a meteor and a pen tip illustrate that a moving point generates a line.
